title: Trinity Generates Numbers — Conditions for Numbering Itself
claim: Numbers do not describe the Trinity. The Trinity generates numbers. 1 requires Being (Father: I AM). 2 requires Distinction (Son: the Word that differentiates). 3 requires Relation (Spirit: the bond that connects). These are not the first three numbers — they are the conditions for numbering itself. Without Being, nothing to count. Without Distinction, nothing else to count. Without Relation, no way to count.
assumptions: The four axioms (A1-A4) map to Trinity persons
negative_guards: This is a theological interpretation of why numbering is possible, not a mathematical proof.
The claim is that the Trinity is generative of number, not described by number.
kill_conditions: Show that numbering is possible without Being, Distinction, or Relation.
Show that a non-triadic structure generates the same conditions.
